name: Dub house sub stabs
desc: Darker dubby sibling: syncopated square-wave sub with rests and offbeat pickups, four-chord G-minor walk (G G/F Eb F) alternating per cycle, resonant 24db filter in the peak and lastOf doubling fills. Sparser and moodier than the .01 roller.

code.full: note("<[g1 ~ [~ g1] ~ bb1 ~ g1 ~] [g1 ~ [~ g1] ~ f1 ~ d1 ~] [eb1 ~ [~ eb1] ~ g1 ~ eb1 ~] [f1 ~ [~ f1] ~ d1 ~ c2 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("square").decay(.22).sustain(.3).release(.08).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.3).slow(16)).lpq(3).shape(.25).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.5, ${gain}).fast(4)).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[g1 g1 [~ g1] g2 bb1 ~ g1 g2] [g1 g1 [~ g1] g2 f1 ~ d1 f1] [eb1 eb1 [~ eb1] eb2 g1 ~ eb1 eb2] [f1 f1 [~ f1] f2 d1 ~ c2 d1]>").add(note(${root})).s("square").ftype('24db').lpf(sine.range(${cut}, ${cut}*1.8).slow(8)).lpq(5).decay(.18).sustain(.2).shape(.3).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.55, ${gain}).fast(4)).lastOf(8, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(3).play()
